reasons: A's first two variants keep the three beats and turn the imperative into a promise from the service, with natural renderings such as «Без ночных звонков» and «Сон — спокойным». B's first variant keeps «Ничего не ломайте», which B itself admits reads as an order to the user, its second variant («Деплой без страха») loses the 'faster' meaning, and it suggests the awkward «Релизьте».
